overview_description.description:
SIDEUP is a one-stop shop for all intelligent technological solutions for micro, small, and medium-sized e-commerce businesses. It gives businesses the tools they need to grow by providing hassle-free local and global logistics support, storage services, and an innovative and real-time dashboard.

Founded in 2019 by Waleed Rashed, the company aims to equip users with the best tools available to provide an unparalleled experience to its customers while simultaneously managing all business needs from a single dashboard and freeing their time from day-to-day logistics.

about_short_description.short_description: SIDEUP help small business in payments, API integration for shipping, warehousing, fulfilment, and advisory with one real time dashboard.

product.name: SIDEUP Ecommerce Shipping Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that lets e-commerce businesses arrange shipments with multiple courier providers through one account and real-time dashboard.

product.name: Courier Marketplace and Delivery Services
product.description: A multi-carrier service for domestic and international door-to-door delivery, enabling merchants to select and use multiple courier companies through SIDEUP.

product.name: Shipment Tracking and Business Reports
product.description: Real-time shipment monitoring and operational reporting tools that help merchants track orders, review delivery activity, and analyze e-commerce performance.

product.name: Payment Gateway Integration
product.description: Payment integration services that support online and cash-on-delivery payment options, including card payments and Fawry in supported markets.

product.name: Store and API Integrations
product.description: Integrations that connect online stores and business systems to SIDEUP for automated order submission and shipping management.

product.name: Warehousing and Fulfillment Services
product.description: Storage and fulfillment support for e-commerce merchants, including product storage, inventory handling, preparation, and packaging through a partner warehouse provider.
